title: Race, consistency and load evidence: the 1.0 reference profile (I21, I22)
summary: Runs the race and consistency suites (engines on three drivers, replica, Redis, extended, --full DB lanes) and the load bench (mini tier on six driver/cache pairs) on the candidate code, records the bench results as the 1.0 reference, deletes the 0.x-era results, rewrites the published-results table and adds the same-host comparison step for later releases.
why: Condition 7 as amended by D24: the candidate's recorded profile is the reference, no comparison with an earlier version. Hard risks: unstable numbers (CV > 10%) published as the reference; engine errors counted as fast denials (the bench counts `*_error` separately and they must be 0); correctness checks of a profile failing unnoticed; later code changes invalidating the profile (P4.8 freeze check).

include: Everything of p4-execution#load: runs, acceptance rules, race.md, load.md
`bench/results/<YYYY-MM-DD>-1.0-<driver>-<cache>-mini.{json,md}` for sqlite/none, sqlite/array, pgsql/none, pgsql/redis, mysql/none, mariadb/none; delete every `bench/results/2026-10-09-*`
`bench/README.md` 'Published results' rewritten from the new files (host, versions, same table shape)
RELEASING.md step 1: the same-host `bench/bin/compare.php` step against the 1.0 reference
`tests/Arch/invariants.json`: I21 checks unchanged; I22 `status: exists`, checks `bench/bin/compare.php`, `bench/README.md`, `tests/Feature/Bench/LoadBenchSmokeTest.php`
exclude: Performance tuning; only a demonstrated defect (correctness failure, engine error) is fixed (convention 1)
ci/ref tiers and the bench workflow

reads.why: Rules every P4 item follows: demonstrated fixes only, stop rule for frozen contracts, 1.0 starting point, owner WIP, pushes, long runs, evidence
Exact commands, PHP 8.4 shim, driver ports, composer update rule, CI evidence procedure
The amended release conditions and which evidence this item contributes
Invariant ids, their checks and statuses
Runs, qualification rules, reference files, freeze dependency
Tiers, profiles, result format, published results to replace

rules: Do not stage, revert or overwrite the owner's uncommitted files (p4-execution#conventions item 6); commit only the item's paths.
No other process runs on the host during a bench run; record the host load before each pair.
guidance: Run the race suites first (they also warm the services), then the bench pairs one after another; each mini pair takes minutes, not seconds. Read the result JSON schema (`bench/schema/result.v1.json`) to extract errors/stable flags for load.md with a short python3 snippet.

validation.cmd: export PGSQL_PORT=25432 MYSQL_PORT=23306 MARIADB_PORT=23307 && composer test:db -- pgsql --engines && composer test:db -- mysql --engines && composer test:db -- mariadb --engines
composer test:replica && composer test:redis && composer test:extended

export PGSQL_PORT=25432 MYSQL_PORT=23306 MARIADB_PORT=23307 && composer test:db -- pgsql --parallel --full && composer test:db -- mysql --parallel --full && composer test:db -- mariadb --parallel --full

for pair in sqlite:none sqlite:array pgsql:none pgsql:redis mysql:none mariadb:none; do d=${pair%:*}; c=${pair#*:}; export PGSQL_PORT=25432 MYSQL_PORT=23306 MARIADB_PORT=23307 && php -d memory_limit=2G -d opcache.enable_cli=1 -d opcache.jit_buffer_size=0 bench/bin/run.php --tier=mini --driver=$d --cache=$c --out=bench/results/$(date +%F)-1.0-$d-$c-mini || exit 1; done
validation.expect: exit 0 for every pair; load.md shows all correctness checks passed, zero *_error, stable stages

validation.cmd: test -z "$(git ls-files 'bench/results/2026-10-09-*')" && ls bench/results/*-1.0-*-mini.json | wc -l | grep -qx 6

deliverables: 1.0 reference bench results and README table

result.notes: Race/consistency green on 3 drivers + replica/redis/extended/--full; six 1.0 bench references recorded (0 errors, all correctness checks pass, some operations unstable on the shared host); 0.x results deleted; README table, RELEASING comparison step and I22 checks done.
deviations: Clean worktree with main vendor instead of CI versions; pgsql/redis repeated after a wrong-port first attempt; second bench pass for unstable stages stopped after 3 of 6 pairs (host noise, no improvement); unstable operations (CV > 10%) remain in the reference and are listed in load.md
